label: rejected
reviewer: blind fresh agent (renders + close-ups + gate report + rubric only)

evidence.V1: Front and silhouette read clearly as a crook staff and A15 Y error is 0.0, but the head has little mass: at 64 px the haft is about 2 px wide, the gem and cap merge into the hook, and the top view is just an unreadable teal pill with a gold disc.
evidence.V2: Big (haft + hook) and medium (gold collar, banded grip, butt cap) shapes are present, but the intended focal point (the gem) is a small inward-facing sliver set inside the cap, so the head has no clear small-detail payoff.
evidence.V3: The whole thing is one uniform-diameter tube bent into a candy-cane hook, with no taper, swell or exaggerated head mass; it reads as stiff primitives with a few rings added.
evidence.V4: The gold collar and grip rings show chamfers that catch light, but the end-cap rim and the step from haft to grip (grip close-up, top and bottom of the wrap) look hard-edged, so the bevels are inconsistent.
evidence.V5: The tube shading is smooth, but the close-ups show stray faceting: the polygonal facets on the gold end-cap's inner rim, the gem's low-segment faceted sphere (gem studio and flat), the hexagonal look of the crook-base collar outline, and the jagged segment corners on the grip-band silhouette.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one hue (teal) in three values (dark haft, mid grip wrap, light gem) plus a gold accent, and the crimson and shadow colourways swap cleanly with the gold kept.
evidence.V7: 1960 tris is under the weapon target of 2500 (ceiling 4000), and A1 passes.
evidence.V8: It uses the one white LF_VertexColor material and the kit palette, but the low-segment faceted cap and gem next to the smooth high-res tube look out of step with the kit's smooth-shaded ~0.045-stud chamfer look. Minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: The studio line is correct: Tool Handle, origin at the grip point, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Faceted polygonal inner rim on the gold end-cap at the crook tip (close_gem_studio, close_gem_flat)
Low-segment gem sphere shows flat facets (close_gem_studio, close_gem_flat)
The crook-base collar outline looks polygonal, not round (close_crook_studio)
Grip-wrap bands have jagged, visible segment corners on the silhouette (close_grip_studio)
Hard unbevelled step where the haft meets the grip wrap (close_grip_studio)
top_fixes: Make the head the focal point: enlarge the gem and turn it outward/forward (or set it on the outer face of the hook) so it reads in front and 3/4 views at 64 px, and give the hook end more mass
Raise the segment counts on the end-cap, gem and collars (or smooth-shade them with weighted normals) to remove the faceting
Add a taper or swell to the haft and hook (thicker near the head, slimmer at the grip) so it stops reading as a uniform tube
Chamfer the haft-to-grip steps and the end-cap rims at about 0.045 studs to match the collar bevels
Smooth the grip-band profile so the wrap silhouette has no jagged segment corners
